title: Treasury Moves to Prevent Abuse of Community Development Financial Institutions Fund Programs
summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury announced on April 27, 2026, that it has initiated a review of certified Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs) to identify potential violations of applicable law or CDFI requirements. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that CDFIs engaging in predatory practices will be reviewed and held accountable where appropriate.
key_points: Treasury is conducting an ongoing review of certified CDFIs for potential violations of law or program requirements
The review aims to ensure CDFIs act as proper stewards of taxpayer funds
Treasury will take action consistent with applicable law and program requirements where appropriate
Secretary Bessent cited commitment to enforcing the law and protecting taxpayer resources
The effort is part of Treasury's broader initiative to strengthen oversight of federal grant programs
